mesh_inner.velocity_definition: Projected FEALPy v = -P*projected(dI/dxi)/tau; Euclidean norm on free scalar dofs
mesh_inner.residual_definition: R_rms = rms(tau*v_i/h_i) on free scalar dofs; h_i=min incident reference edge length
mesh_inner.rmse_sampling: 100x100 midpoint interpolation samples, not PDE error

method: P1 nonlinear Galerkin / backward Euler / Picard / nonconservative P1 rezoning
field_origin: Initial FE data transferred by P1; PDE time is not advanced
transfer: Interpolate the fixed t_n FE field onto each trial mesh; not mass conservative

fixed_grid_baseline.method: P1 nonlinear Galerkin / backward Euler / Picard / nonconservative P1 rezoning
fixed_grid_baseline.field_origin: Initial FE data transferred by P1; PDE time is not advanced
fixed_grid_baseline.transfer: Interpolate the fixed t_n FE field onto each trial mesh; not mass conservative
